definition.en: A number that names part of a whole cut into equal parts. {3/4} means 3 of 4 equal parts.
definition.zh: 表示一个整体被平均分后其中几份的数。{3/4} 表示平均分成 4 份中的 3 份。

definition.en: The one thing that is cut into equal parts: one strip, one prata, the stretch from 0 to 1 on a number line. All its parts together make 1 whole, so {4/4} = 1.
definition.zh: 被平均分的那一个东西：一条纸条、一张 prata、数轴上 0 到 1 的一段。所有的份合起来是 1 个整体，所以 {4/4} = 1。

definition.en: Parts that are all the same amount. They need not be the same shape: a square cut corner to corner gives two equal halves.
definition.zh: 每一份都一样多。形状不一定相同：正方形沿对角线切开，得到的两半也是平均分。

definition.en: The top number of a fraction: how many equal parts are taken. In {3/8} the numerator is 3.
definition.zh: 分数线上面的数：取了几份。{3/8} 的分子是 3。

definition.en: The bottom number of a fraction: how many equal parts the whole is cut into. In {3/8} the denominator is 8.
definition.zh: 分数线下面的数：整体平均分成几份。{3/8} 的分母是 8。

definition.en: A fraction with 1 on top: one of the equal parts, such as {1/2}, {1/4} or {1/12}.
definition.zh: 分子是 1 的分数，表示其中一份，如 {1/2}、{1/4}、{1/12}。（大陆课本把这样的一份叫作“分数单位”。）

definition.en: Fractions with the same denominator, such as {2/7} and {5/7}: their parts are the same size. Fractions with different denominators, such as {2/3} and {3/4}, are unlike fractions.
definition.zh: 分母相同的分数，如 {2/7} 和 {5/7}：它们的每一份一样大。分母不同的分数，如 {2/3} 和 {3/4}，叫异分母分数。

definition.en: Fractions that name the same amount, such as {1/2}, {2/4} and {4/8}. To find one, multiply or divide the top and the bottom by the same number.
definition.zh: 表示同样多的分数，如 {1/2}、{2/4}、{4/8}。分子和分母同时乘或除以同一个数，就得到等值分数。（大陆课本也说“大小相等的分数”。）

definition.en: A fraction is in simplest form when no number except 1 divides both its top and its bottom, such as {3/4}. {6/8} in simplest form is {3/4}.
definition.zh: 除了 1 以外，没有数能同时整除分子和分母的分数，如 {3/4}。{6/8} 化成最简分数是 {3/4}。把分子和分母同时除以同一个数，叫约分。

definition.en: Fractions where one denominator is a multiple of the other, such as {1/2} and {3/8}. Each half is 4 eighths, so the half can be renamed in eighths before adding, subtracting or comparing.
definition.zh: 一个分母是另一个分母的倍数的分数，如 {1/2} 和 {3/8}。每个二分之一是 4 个八分之一，所以加、减或比较之前，可以先把二分之一换成八分之几。

definition.en: A line on which every number has its place. From 0 to 1 is one whole; cut it into 4 equal jumps, and the end of the third jump is {3/4}. Count the jumps, not the marks.
definition.zh: 每个数都有自己位置的一条线。0 到 1 是一个整体；平均分成 4 段，第三段的终点就是 {3/4}。数的是段，不是刻度线。

definition.en: A whole number and a fraction together, such as {1 3/4}, read one and three quarters. It is the same amount as the improper fraction {7/4}, whose top is at least as big as its bottom.
definition.zh: 整数和分数合在一起，如 {1 3/4}，读作一又四分之三。它和假分数 {7/4} 一样多；假分数的分子大于或等于分母。
